limits: The calibration is against jev-1.13.0 on 24 September 2026. A later model may score differently, which is why harness/measure_criteria.py is committed rather than only its table; rerun it when the model version moves.
Three genuine records and two synthetic controls is a small sample. It shows the direction and the widening gap, not a guarantee that no record can pass by naming an unknown it never resolves.
The review was a self-review, like every ticket in this epic. An independent pass over the harness is still owed.
Only the clarified question changed. The other six keep whatever calibration they have, measured or not.
